visual_logic.surface_detail: Thick, leathery skin with 'Dark Green-Grey' mottling; tactile ridges along the spine for a more 'armored' appearance.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the jaw—extremely long with an unusual abundance of small, sharp teeth ('Pluridens' meaning 'many teeth').
visual_logic.facial_expression: A more rugged, 'tough' look compared to Halisaurus, with deep-set, soulful amber eyes.

environment.water: Murky 'River-Silt' brown transitioning to deep teal; reflecting a high-energy coastal environment.
environment.biota: Mangrove-like 'Roots' submerged in the background and schools of large, armored fish.

visual_logic.pose: A powerful forward lunge, mouth slightly agape to showcase the unique dental arrangement and jaw length.
